comments.value: You can now favorite more worlds with four more rows (a total of +400 favorite worlds) in [VRChat 2026.1.1](https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/vrchat-202611), for VRC+ subscribers.

details:
I loved the big old update where the creators increased the limits on different things.

Before i start, i have VRC+

In my view. I feel like its not enough yet. It would also be nice to have more slots for favoriting different things and not only many favorites only on a few slots. More slots means more potential for people to keep order in their favorites from worlds, friends to avatars.

Currently there are only 4 different World slots. Alot of worlds to be favorited. Yet it also means that worlds will just be thrown into there without order. And for many people that will just end up being hoarding and difficult to find through where specific or different worlds potentially are. As there is a cap on 400 worlds which is by itself alot on only 4 different slots.

I currently have 4 different names for them. Favorite avatar worlds. Chill homes/Areas, Event/Fun Maps, Other.

For me having more slots than less slots but with the same amount wouldve been better. As the idea would probably be to not increase the amount. Probably. Yet for users the more, the better. As having a small limit sucks.

Avatars for me have a better system as its easier to keep order as there are more slots. There are currently 6 slots + an extra slot for avis. 6 being choosable and the extra being uploaded slot. Yet i do still wish there were more avatar slots. Yet that will stay as my christmas wish. Im a collector for avatars, and it is fun to find random public avatars and also keep order so that im sure what i have stored in the different slots and also easy to find things and choose. 

And lastly Friends slots.

My biggest wish out of all these 3 is to increase the friends favorites slots. Currently there are only 4 different slots for friends. And considering how many friends i have, 4 slots is not enough and not much. As having different slots for friends can help alot! For example they could be your best friends, or maybe they are your club people, maybe they are just funny haha people, maybe they are people you are trying to get closer to, maybe they are inactive but you like them but the other slots are full, sleep friend, game friend, family, or maybe it is someone you have had disagreements with and are keeping an eye on?

Especially the last section would be helpful for people with bad memory, hoarding and also needing of order and stability in their friend tab. And potentially fun to sort people into different slots is fun too.

I myself tend to have a friend system to see how close they are to me. Meaning priority to my attention. Which is a preference, But is something that depends on person to person. 

If all of this is problematic to increase the limit on things. It would atleast be nice to make it optionable for people to either combine slots or spread slots for their own preference.

Thank you for hearing my idea! I am not trying to start a war. All I wanted, was to express my wishes for an easier system personally and potentially for others.

<3 <3 <3
title: More Favorite slots (Worlds, Avatars, Friends)
